purpose: Categorize every PMP Lossless Inventory Vault record so the vault can track records without storing every full report forever.

history_snapshot.role: Important milestone snapshot worth preserving as a full record.
history_snapshot.promotion_rule: only when app state, route architecture, privacy boundary, or major inventory shape materially changes

delta_record.role: What changed since previous accepted report.
delta_record.promotion_rule: create for every accepted current update once previous baseline exists

app_inventory.role: Counts and lists of active/inactive/helper/support app files and live app screen structure.

theme_review.role: Pages needing room shell, Control Room mold, contrast, outline, spacing, tabs, button, and card checks.

privacy_surface.role: Private/sensitive surfaces by key name and route, without storing private values.

version_route_control.role: Current/active/archive/helper status and route aliases/current pointers.

shortcut_writer_test.role: Records about iPhone Shortcut, GitHub Issue Inbox, write success/failure, token route, and handoff tests.

error_record.role: Failures that must not be confused with valid inventory truth.

decision_record.role: Human/assistant decision records, including abandoned paths and active paths.

routing_rule: Every inbox item must be classified before it becomes current, history, delta, test, error, or ignored.
space_rule: The ledger keeps all records compactly. Full reports are stored only as current, selected history, or external source pointers. Test/noise comments should not become permanent full snapshots.
